title: fuse-flow policy overrides
description: Values that replace the defaults of fuse-flow and of the workflows. The files, from the most general to the most specific: ~/.konductor/policy-overrides.yml (the user's, below the workflow), .konductor/policy-overrides.yml (the team's, in git) and .konductor/policy-overrides.local.yml (the user's for this project, gitignored); each overrides the ones before it.

checks.description: Each kind of check a workflow's `check:` gates name, bound to the command that runs it from the repository root, or to `none` where the kind does not apply. Engine effect: a `check` gate runs the bound command; a kind bound to none passes and is reported as not configured in this project.

max_rounds.description: The round cap of every agent gate. Engine effect: printed as the cap.

guide.description: A review guide for every agent gate, relative to this file or absolute. It replaces the guides of the workflow's gates and the artifacts' review guides. Engine effect: printed with the gate.

reviewer.description: Who reviews, in words, such as a model or a harness. Engine effect: printed with the gate.
examples: a different model from the one that did the work

reviewers.description: The reviewer's model for each model an author may run on, by the author's model name. The layers merge by author model, the more specific file winning. Engine effect: printed with the gate; the agent picks the row for its own model.

model.description: The model the reviewer runs on.

effort.description: The reasoning effort, such as high.

launch.description: How to start this reviewer, when it differs from `review.launch`, for example a model the agent's harness cannot run.

command.description: The shell command that runs one review, from the repository root. `{model}`, `{effort}`, `{prompt_file}` and `{findings_file}` are replaced: the agent writes the review request to the prompt file, and the reviewer writes its findings to the findings file.

launch.description: How the agent starts a reviewer: `subagent`, a fresh subagent in the agent's own harness (the default), or a command such as another harness on the terminal. A reviewer row's own launch wins. Engine effect: printed with the gate.

command.description: The shell command that runs one review, from the repository root. `{model}`, `{effort}`, `{prompt_file}` and `{findings_file}` are replaced: the agent writes the review request to the prompt file, and the reviewer writes its findings to the findings file.

rulings.description: The owner's rulings where fuse-flow and another installed skill or always-on instruction overlap, in plain sentences, such as which of two review mechanisms runs. Every layer's rulings apply, the more specific file's last. Engine effect: printed with every step.
examples: In fuse-flow workstreams, the workflow's review gates replace the code-review skill's own review loop.

artifacts.description: Where this project keeps an artifact, by artifact id, relative to the repository root; `{slug}` is replaced with the workstream's slug and `{date}` with the local date the workstream started. Engine effect: replaces the path the workflow gives.
